title: Repo-wide pre-commit hooks must set always_run: true
answers: pre-commit hook skipped on deletion-only commit
unused media not caught when deleting a doc reference
how to make a pre-commit hook run without staged files
body:
Convention: a pre-commit hook that checks the whole repo, not specific files, must set `pass_filenames: false` and `always_run: true`.
Why: pre-commit skips hooks when no staged file matches their `files`/`types` filter, and deleted paths are excluded from the candidate list. A commit that only deletes the last reference to a media file would otherwise never trigger the check.
Where: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` entry `unused-media` (entry `dev/find-unused-media.sh`, language `system`).
Constraints: applies to hooks whose result does not depend on which files changed. Hooks scoped to particular file types (like the `*.gif` hook beside it) should keep their `files:` filter instead.
applies: Any new or edited hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml whose check is repo-wide.
says: Commit checks for unused media do not run when only deleting file references.
Unreferenced documentation images are missed when submitting deletion-only changes.
Ensure repository-wide cleanup checks trigger even when no new files are staged.
Unused media check is skipped on pull requests that solely remove content.
search: Repository-wide pre-commit hooks in .pre-commit-config.yaml must configure pass_filenames: false and always_run: true. This ensures checks like dev/find-unused-media.sh execute even on commits that only delete files or references without staging matching paths. Applies to any repository-wide hook whose outcome is independent of specific changed files, while file-type scoped hooks should retain their files filter.
